<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#063336" flood-opacity=".10"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F9FAFA"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height=" thirty" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="19" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">9:41</text>
  <line x1="329" y1="16" x2="333" y2="16" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="337" y1="13" x2="341" y2="16" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="346" y1="10" x2="350" y2="16" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="359" cy="15" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="359" y1="15" x2="359" y2="11" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="370" y="9" width="17" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="372" y="11" width="11" height="8" rx="2" fill="#5DB329"/>
  <rect x="387" y="13" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#121212"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <rect x="0" y="30" width="390" height="68" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="48" width="40" height="40" rx="20" fill="#F2F4F8"/>
    <polyline points="40,61 33,68 40,75" fill="none" stroke="#0A2533" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="34" y1="68" x2="47" y2="68" stroke="#0A2533" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <text x="75" y="72" font-family="Poppins" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Card details</text>
  <line x1="0" y1="98" x2="390" y2="98" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- card visual -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="20" y="116" width="350" height="190" rx="20" fill="#0A2533"/>
    <rect x="20" y="116" width="350" height="190" rx="20" fill="#123E43" opacity=".46"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="312" cy="153" r="22" fill="#EC2A38"/>
  <circle cx="330" cy="153" r="22" fill="#FBBD00" opacity=".92"/>
  <text x="38" y="153" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">MINT CARD</text>
  <rect x="39" y="177" width="44" height="32" rx="6" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="187" x2="82" y2="187" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="198" x2="82" y2="198" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="39" y="243" font-family="Poppins" font-size="19" font-weight="500" letter-spacing="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF">5284 1937 0428 7716</text>
  <text x="39" y="276" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#ADD993">CARDHOLDER</text>
  <text x="39" y="292" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">MAYA THOMPSON</text>
  <text x="273" y="276" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#ADD993">EXPIRES</text>
  <text x="273" y="292" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">08/28</text>

  <!-- information heading -->
  <text x="20" y="337" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Card information</text>
  <text x="20" y="358" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Your payment details are encrypted and secure.</text>

  <!-- fields -->
  <text x="20" y="385" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#333333">Card number</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="393" width="350" height="48" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="36" y="423" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">5284 1937 0428 7716</text>
    <rect x="328" y="408" width="27" height="18" rx="3" fill="#EC2A38"/>
    <circle cx="348" cy="417" r="9" fill="#FBBD00" opacity=".9"/>
  </g>

  <text x="20" y="465" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#333333">Expiry date</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="473" width="166" height="48" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="36" y="503" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">08 / 28</text>
  </g>
  <text x="204" y="465" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#333333">CVC</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="204" y="473" width="166" height="48" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="220" y="503" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16" font-weight="500" letter-spacing="3" fill="#333333">•••</text>
    <circle cx="347" cy="497" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="344" y="501" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#97A2B0">?</text>
  </g>

  <!-- billing row -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="543" width="350" height="62" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="49" cy="574" r="18" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
    <rect x="40" y="568" width="18" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#4B9460" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="40" y1="572" x2="58" y2="572" stroke="#4B9460" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="78" y="569" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#333333">Billing address</text>
    <text x="78" y="588" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Same as your delivery address</text>
    <polyline points="348,570 354,576 348,582" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- security -->
  <text x="20" y="636" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Security</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="648" width="350" height="58" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="49" cy="677" r="18" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
    <rect x="43" y="675" width="12" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#4B9460" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <polyline points="45,675 45,670 47,667 51,667 54,670 54,675" fill="none" stroke="#4B9460" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="78" y="674" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#333333">Card security</text>
    <text x="78" y="692" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Protected with 3D Secure</text>
    <rect x="321" y="668" width="34" height="20" rx="10" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <circle cx="345" cy="678" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- action buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="719" width="350" height="48" rx="12" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <text x="195" y="749" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Save changes</text>
  </g>

  <!-- navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="784" width="390" height="60" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="784" x2="390" y2="784" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,802 49,794 59,802 59,814 52,814 52,806 46,806 46,814 39,814" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="49" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#97A2B0">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="127" cy="803" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="133" y1="809" x2="139" y2="815" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="127" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#97A2B0">Search</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="190" y="796" width="20" height="15" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <polygon points="195,811 199,815 203,811" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <circle cx="207" cy="798" r="3" fill="#EC2A38"/>
    <text x="200" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">Activity</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="278" cy="800" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <ellipse cx="278" cy="812" rx="11" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="278" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#97A2B0">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="346" cy="802" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <circle cx="346" cy="802" r="3" fill="#97A2B0"/>
    <line x1="346" y1="790" x2="346" y2="794" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="346" y1="810" x2="346" y2="814" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="346" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#97A2B0">Settings</text>
  </g>
</svg>
